narr: The end of July continued to be busy for meteorologists at the Albuquerque National Weather Service Office as numerous thunderstorms impacted the area on July 30, 2022. With well above normal moisture available in the atmosphere, these thunderstorms were robust and very capable of producing heavy rainfall. Several flash flooding reports were received, including in the Rio Rancho and Edgewood areas.
ev: Heavy rain in the Rio Rancho and Vista Hills areas caused flooding. At a home in Rio Rancho, standing water was reported two inches deep in someone's backyard. In Vista Hills, dirt roads were flooded and arroyos were reported to be running. Damages are estimated.
A trained spotter near Edgewood reported that their home was inundated with water from flash flooding. Damages are estimated.

Heavy rain of 3.5 to 4 inches caused flash flooding south of Clayton. A trained spotter reported that the heavy rain caused Carrizo Creek to overflow its banks. Standing water and debris was reported across area roadways and within fields. Damages are estimated.
